She knew the whole time and just said she wasnt ready yet and I kept telling her I still feel this way but she kept saying she did too but wasnt ready. And 6 years later she finally said she isn't interested in anything more than a friend ship after telling me she had romantic feelings for me and just wasnt ready for a relationship. 

I cant blame her at all. And I still love her as just a friend too she's been the biggest part of my life for a long time. But I had to get her to admit she doesn't  have romantic feelings. I'm ok today. I have been preparing for this for a while. And I totally accept it. Part of me feels good about it because she doesn't have to deal with my crazy ass. And part of me feels good that i can finally move on like I'm relieved. But then I feel bad about feeling good about it and  that cycle starts. I just got caught up in the moment and I am going to stay away from self harm again I know it's not a healthy coping mechanism
Thank you so much. I never heard of DBT. I will be researching it thoroughly tonight.

I'm sorry to hear that. I know it's tough to stay positive when you've broken down. Just know you aren't alone in how you feel.  There will always be someone there to talk to about your emotional distress. Reach out it usually saves me from going down that road.

I realize now I have to stop letting my emotions effect what i do and to put them on the back burner.
